bayts.text: O You Who spared me every wretched one, and have been for me with joy and permanence,
bless with a blessing that makes known hidden things him who drove away faults,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, to the Family and the Companions; and magnify my pen.
O You Who lead to me from the Tablet the wonder, O You Who lead to me the benefits of Rajab,
bless with a blessing clear of all idle talk the Prophet of Allah, light of the eloquent.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise to him, through him, my writing without rejection, and accept my life through him.
And protect me from every toil and illness, and grant me the greatest in every aim.
And toward other than my body turn illness, and toward others than me drive the enemies.
O You Who gifted me what became clear to me, O You Who lead to me benefit in Shaʿbān,
bless with a blessing that makes (good) everlasting for me and never ceases to repel enemies, together, in secret and in public,
toward other than my person, and makes the rebel despair of me and of what You chose for me, O Willer.
with a peace that has no end, upon the Prophet who commands and forbids.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make these letters of mine a shield (junna) for me against enemies and a garden (janna) for the Garden.
O You Who granted me the best outpouring, and bestowed on me a grace in the month of Ramaḍān,
bless with a blessing that leads to me all You have chosen for me, as a ladder to the Gardens,
with a peace that draws sweetness to me in Your Book during recitation;
and may both unveil to me all that was hidden of the sciences, and protect (me) from illusion,
upon him to whom You gave from Yourself the wise Remembrance, and through whom You illumined the heart of the wise,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And send misery and toil toward others than us, and grant us wealth.
And drive out of every heart that has aimed (at me) what grieves me — what grieves me —, wherever it lies in wait.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, You are the Patron (Al-Wālī), O You Who lead good to me in Shawwāl,
bless with a blessing that draws security, that makes heart and times good for me,
with a peace that makes clarity everlasting, that makes all of me a healing for creation,
upon him whose (truth that) I am his servant has appeared on land and sea, and who for me has subdued my adversary.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And let the enemies know that I am with You, not with them: glad tidings for Your hosts.
Make it clear to them with the clarifying of Him from Whom nothing is hidden, leading to me what is most hidden.
O Guide (Al-Murshid) Who led Your right direction to me, O You to Whom (goes) my gratitude from Dhū l-Qaʿda,
bless with a blessing that makes my sitting (in retreat) good in every month, and leads through me the blessed one
to You, with the Remembrance and the ḥadīth, with wisdoms, O Giver of transmission,
upon him through whom You made my soul good, just as through him You granted me guidance and wisdoms.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And send whoever wills all that grieves me toward a (place) other than my harm, marked out (as his).
And do not turn the wrongdoers toward my directions, and drive away my envier and his pain.
O You Who protected me, (as) model and proof, from Muḥarram to Dhū l-Ḥijja,
and have been for me in every month and year, O You Who are exalted above sleep and slumber (Qurʾān 2:255),
bless with a blessing that brings my wishes into being and leads ʿArafāt and Minā to me,
with a peace that extinguishes every evil and leads every praised good to me,
upon him the serving of whom led to me what did not yield to others than me, and yielded (to me).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my letters, through the most excellent of mankind, forever, good pleasure for him, the highest of glad tidings.
O You Who granted me the months as joy, for me, for me You made them all good together, and the ten (days),
You have led to me what is manifest and what is hidden, and joy appeared to me in the days of Minā.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to shine, whose lights cut through every veil,
with a peace whose light purifies the heart of the one who blesses and through it makes it skilled,
upon him whom I made my means of approach to You, and who led to me right guidance and his word.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
